updated_by: Opus encounter — seed data from ecosystem research
note: This directory grows via Layer 1 weak tie sensing. New tools added after human review.

tools.name: CiviCRM
tools.what_it_does: Open-source constituent relationship management for nonprofits. Contacts, memberships, donations, events, mailings, case management.
tools.strengths: Mature, well-supported, strong community. Handles most CRM needs for small-medium NFPs. WordPress and Drupal integration.
tools.limitations: Setup complexity for small orgs without tech capacity. Hosting requires some technical knowledge or a managed provider.

tools.name: Loomio
tools.what_it_does: Collaborative decision-making platform. Proposals, polls, discussions, threads. Designed for democratic governance.
tools.strengths: Purpose-built for the kind of decisions community orgs actually make. Cooperative-owned. Aotearoa roots — culturally aligned.
tools.limitations: Another tool to check. Adoption requires behaviour change — people default to email.

tools.name: Decidim
tools.what_it_does: Participatory democracy platform. Proposals, budgets, assemblies, consultations. Designed for citizen participation at scale.
tools.strengths: Powerful for large-scale consultation. Open source, well-funded by Barcelona City Council origins. Multi-language.
tools.limitations: Overkill for small orgs. Setup requires Rails knowledge. Better for councils and peak bodies than individual NFPs.

tools.name: Open Food Network
tools.what_it_does: Open-source platform for local food distribution. Online shopfronts, hub management, producer profiles.
tools.strengths: Strong Australian presence (OFN Australia). Community-owned. Proven at scale.
tools.limitations: Food-specific. Not generalisable to other community needs without significant adaptation.
tools.known_deployments_wa: Active in WA — OFN Australia has WA hubs

tools.name: Bonfire Networks
tools.what_it_does: Federated social networking toolkit. Modular, customisable, ActivityPub-compatible. Build your own social space.
tools.strengths: Genuinely sovereign — communities own their instance. Federated by design. Modular architecture.
tools.limitations: Early stage. Technical setup required. Small community. Not ready for non-technical deployment.

tools.name: Hypha Worker Co-operative
tools.what_it_does: Not a tool — a cooperative that builds and maintains digital infrastructure for communities. Consulting + hosting + development.
tools.strengths: Model for how Kamunity itself could operate. Deep expertise in cooperative digital infrastructure.
tools.limitations: Based in Toronto. Not directly deployable in WA. Value is as model and ally, not service provider.

tools.name: Humanitix
tools.what_it_does: Event ticketing platform that donates profits to children's charities. Australian-founded.
tools.strengths: Drop-in Eventbrite replacement with social mission. Easy to use. Australian. Free for free events.
tools.limitations: Not open source. Platform dependency still exists, just with better values.
tools.known_deployments_wa: Widely used in WA community sector

tools.name: Tally
tools.what_it_does: Form builder. Free tier is generous. Clean, simple, no-code.
tools.strengths: Replaces Google Forms and Typeform for most use cases. Generous free tier. Simple to use.
tools.limitations: Not open source. Data stored on their servers. But pragmatically better than Google for privacy.

tools.name: Baserow
tools.what_it_does: Open-source Airtable alternative. No-code database with views, forms, automations.
tools.strengths: Self-hostable. Open source. Replaces Airtable dependency. Good for small org data management.
tools.limitations: Self-hosting requires technical capacity. Cloud version is a SaaS dependency.

tools.name: Kamunity Grants Hub
tools.what_it_does: Grant acquittal and reporting helper for WA community sector organisations. Built by Kamunity.
tools.strengths: Purpose-built for WA NFPs. Free. No account required. Directly addresses the most common signal pattern (grant acquittal). Kamunity-maintained.
tools.limitations: Early stage — live testing phase. Limited to grant reporting use case.
tools.known_deployments_wa: Live — Kamunity ecosystem tool, built for WA sector

tools.name: Nextcloud
tools.what_it_does: Self-hosted file storage, collaboration, and office suite. Google Workspace / Microsoft 365 alternative.
tools.strengths: True sovereignty — your data, your server. Mature. Full office suite. Calendar, contacts, email integration.
tools.limitations: Requires hosting and maintenance. Not practical for orgs without any tech capacity unless using managed hosting.

taxonomy_notes: wa_sector_fit scored 1-10 based on: ease of adoption for small NFPs (weight 3), sovereignty alignment (weight 2), existing WA presence (weight 2), maturity (weight 2), cost (weight 1). Scores are initial estimates — to be validated through sector research and user feedback.
